_aciklama: Sinif presetleri (gorev #286): create sirasinda <Isim>/anims.json'a kopyalanir. 'fbx' Mixamo arsivindeki TAM dosya adidir (tools/mixamo_downloader/animations). 'groups' ayni tuvali paylasan klipler - manken kamerasi grubun tum kliplerini kapsayacak sekilde kurulur (bbox_fbx). prop bos string = o klipte silah yok.

idle.pose: A warrior woman stands in a ready stance holding a large two-handed greatsword, breathing, subtle sway. plain solid flat uniform light gray seamless background, no floor shadow, static camera, full body always visible from head to feet.

attack.pose: A warrior woman gripping a large two-handed greatsword performs a powerful sword slash attack with the whole body, then returns to her stance. plain solid flat uniform light gray seamless background, no floor shadow, static camera, full body always visible from head to feet.

skill.pose: A warrior woman spins with her greatsword in a wide high spinning attack, then lands back in her stance. plain solid flat uniform light gray seamless background, no floor shadow, static camera, full body always visible from head to feet.
